summary: Synthesised drum kit in the TR-909 and TR-808 manner: kick, snare, clap, rim, closed and open hats (the closed one chokes the open one), low, mid and high toms, cowbell, crash and ride, each with its tune, decay, tone or snap (and the kick its sweep, click and drive), level and pan. Plays the General MIDI drum keys from C2 (kick C2, snare D2, closed hat F#2, open hat A#2), as Neo Sampler's Kit mode does, or per-track hit columns (BD, SD, … with a velocity) and an Accent column, as Buzz drum machines do. Velocity sets the level and opens the tone. Use it for drum parts.
use_for: A complete synthesised drum kit: kick, snare, clap, rim and hats with a pattern-friendly keymap.

parameters.name: Volume
parameters.description: Output level
parameters.how: Sets the overall output level of the kit, from -60 to +12 dB, or off.
parameters.sound: Use it to place the whole kit in the mix without changing the balance between drums.

parameters.name: Accent gain
parameters.description: How much louder an accented hit plays (a hit on a row with Accent): a TR-909's accent
parameters.how: Sets how much louder an accented hit plays, from 0 to 12 dB.
parameters.sound: Accented steps jump out of the pattern and give it a human, driving push.

parameters.name: Vel → level
parameters.description: How much velocity sets a hit's level: the gain is velocity^(2 × this) (100 %: velocity 64 is −12 dB; 0 %: every hit at full level)
parameters.how: Sets how strongly velocity changes the level of a hit, from 0 to 100 %.
parameters.sound: High values give a lively, dynamic kit, and 0 % makes every hit equally loud like a drum machine.

parameters.name: Vel → tone
parameters.description: How much velocity (and accent) opens a hit: the kick's click and sweep, the snare's snap and tone, the toms' attack, the hats' and cymbals' tone; a hit at velocity 100 sounds as its parameters say
parameters.how: Sets how much velocity and accent open up the tone of a hit, from 0 to 100 %.
parameters.sound: Harder hits get a sharper click, snap and brightness, and softer ones sound duller and rounder.

parameters.name: Kick tune
parameters.description: The body's pitch once its sweep has settled
parameters.how: Sets the pitch the kick body settles on, from 30 to 150 Hz.
parameters.sound: Low values give a deep sub thump, and higher ones a tighter, more tonal kick.

parameters.name: Kick sweep
parameters.description: How far above its tune the body starts, falling to it
parameters.how: Sets how far above its tune the kick starts, from 0 to 48 semitones.
parameters.sound: More sweep gives a stronger pitch-drop zap at the start, and none gives a flat sine boom.

parameters.name: Kick sweep time
parameters.description: The sweep's time constant: the pitch is 63 % of the way down after this
parameters.how: Sets how quickly the kick falls from its start pitch to its tune, from 2 to 200 ms.
parameters.sound: Short sweeps sound clicky and tight, and long ones sound like a falling laser.

parameters.name: Kick decay
parameters.description: Time for the body to fall 60 dB
parameters.how: Sets how long the kick body takes to die away, from 0.05 to 4 seconds.
parameters.sound: Short decays make a tight kick, and long ones a booming, held bass note.

parameters.name: Kick click
parameters.description: Level of the attack's click (a short burst of high-passed noise)
parameters.how: Sets the level of the noisy click at the start of the kick, from 0 to 100 %.
parameters.sound: More click makes the beater attack audible and helps the kick cut through a mix.

parameters.name: Kick punch
parameters.description: How much louder the body starts (up to +12 dB at 100 %), falling back with the sweep: a TR-909's attack
parameters.how: Boosts the level of the kick's first moments by up to 12 dB, from 0 to 100 %.
parameters.sound: More punch gives a harder, more percussive attack that then settles into the body.

parameters.name: Kick drive
parameters.description: Saturation of the body, its level kept
parameters.how: Adds saturation to the kick body, from 0 to 24 dB, keeping its level.
parameters.sound: A little adds harmonics so the kick reads on small speakers, and a lot makes it gritty.

parameters.name: Kick level
parameters.description: Level of the kick
parameters.how: Sets the level of the kick, from -60 to +6 dB, or off.
parameters.sound: Use it to balance the kick against the other drums.

parameters.name: Kick pan
parameters.description: Where the kick sits, from −100 % (left) to +100 % (right)
parameters.how: Places the kick from 100 % left to 100 % right.
parameters.sound: The centre is the usual place for a kick; moving it makes the kit feel off-balance.

parameters.name: Snare tune
parameters.description: The body's lower tone, once its short fall has settled (the upper sits an octave above)
parameters.how: Sets the lower tone of the snare body, from 100 to 400 Hz.
parameters.sound: Lower values sound fat and deep, and higher ones sound thin and tight.

parameters.name: Snare tone
parameters.description: Centre of the snappy noise's band (from about half of it to 1.3 times it): brighter up
parameters.how: Sets the centre of the snappy noise band, from 1 to 16 kHz.
parameters.sound: Higher values give a bright, crisp rattle, and lower ones a darker, rounder one.

parameters.name: Snare snap
parameters.description: The snappy noise against the body (0 %: the body alone)
parameters.how: Sets the level of the snappy noise against the body, from 0 to 100 %.
parameters.sound: Zero leaves only the drum body, while more snap adds the sizzle of the snare wires.

parameters.name: Snare decay
parameters.description: Time for the snappy noise to fall 60 dB (the body takes about half)
parameters.how: Sets how long the snare noise rings, from 0.05 to 2 seconds.
parameters.sound: Short decays are dry and snappy, and long ones add a washy tail.

parameters.name: Snare level
parameters.description: Level of the snare
parameters.how: Sets the level of the snare, from -60 to +6 dB, or off.
parameters.sound: Use it to balance the snare against the other drums.

parameters.name: Snare pan
parameters.description: Where the snare sits, from −100 % (left) to +100 % (right)
parameters.how: Places the snare from 100 % left to 100 % right.
parameters.sound: Centre is standard; a slight offset gives a more natural kit image.

parameters.name: Clap tune
parameters.description: Centre of the clap's band-pass
parameters.how: Sets the centre frequency of the clap, from 500 Hz to 5 kHz.
parameters.sound: Lower values sound thick and woody, and higher ones sharp and papery.

parameters.name: Clap spread
parameters.description: Time between the clap's three bursts
parameters.how: Sets the time between the clap's three bursts, from 2 to 30 ms.
parameters.sound: Short spreads sound like one tight clap, and longer ones like several people clapping.

parameters.name: Clap decay
parameters.description: Time for its tail to fall 60 dB
parameters.how: Sets how long the clap tail rings, from 0.05 to 2 seconds.
parameters.sound: Short decays are dry, and long ones add a roomy tail.

parameters.name: Clap level
parameters.description: Level of the clap
parameters.how: Sets the level of the clap, from -60 to +6 dB, or off.
parameters.sound: Use it to balance the clap against the other drums.

parameters.name: Clap pan
parameters.description: Where the clap sits, from −100 % (left) to +100 % (right)
parameters.how: Places the clap from 100 % left to 100 % right.
parameters.sound: Off-centre claps help them sit beside the snare.

parameters.name: Rim tune
parameters.description: Pitch of the rim shot's highest ping (the others sit at half and 0.23 of it)
parameters.how: Sets the pitch of the rim shot, from 400 Hz to 4 kHz.
parameters.sound: Low values sound woody and dull, and high ones sound sharp and metallic.

parameters.name: Rim decay
parameters.description: Time for its pings to fall 60 dB
parameters.how: Sets how long the rim shot rings, from 10 to 500 ms.
parameters.sound: Short decays are a dry click, and longer ones let the ping ring.

parameters.name: Rim level
parameters.description: Level of the rim shot
parameters.how: Sets the level of the rim shot, from -60 to +6 dB, or off.
parameters.sound: Use it to balance the rim shot against the other drums.

parameters.name: Rim pan
parameters.description: Where the rim shot sits, from −100 % (left) to +100 % (right)
parameters.how: Places the rim shot from 100 % left to 100 % right.
parameters.sound: Moving it aside gives a sparse beat more width.

parameters.name: Closed hat tune
parameters.description: Pitch of the six metallic oscillators, in semitones from the TR-808's
parameters.how: Shifts the pitch of the closed hat by up to 12 semitones either way.
parameters.sound: Lower values sound heavier and darker, and higher ones thinner and brighter.

parameters.name: Closed hat tone
parameters.description: Centre of the band the hats ring in (more above it, a little across the mids): brighter up
parameters.how: Sets the centre of the band the closed hat rings in, from 2 to 16 kHz.
parameters.sound: Higher values give a bright, sizzling hat, and lower ones a duller, softer one.

parameters.name: Closed hat decay
parameters.description: Time to fall 60 dB
parameters.how: Sets how long the closed hat rings, from 10 ms to 1 second.
parameters.sound: Short decays tick tightly, and longer ones sound looser and more open.

parameters.name: Closed hat level
parameters.description: Level of the closed hat
parameters.how: Sets the level of the closed hat, from -60 to +6 dB, or off.
parameters.sound: Use it to balance the hat against the other drums.

parameters.name: Closed hat pan
parameters.description: Where the closed hat sits, from −100 % (left) to +100 % (right)
parameters.how: Places the closed hat from 100 % left to 100 % right.
parameters.sound: Moving the hats slightly off-centre widens the top of the kit.

parameters.name: Open hat tune
parameters.description: Pitch of the six metallic oscillators, in semitones from the TR-808's
parameters.how: Shifts the pitch of the open hat by up to 12 semitones either way.
parameters.sound: Lower values sound heavier and darker, and higher ones thinner and brighter.

parameters.name: Open hat tone
parameters.description: Centre of the band the hats ring in (more above it, a little across the mids): brighter up
parameters.how: Sets the centre of the band the open hat rings in, from 2 to 16 kHz.
parameters.sound: Higher values give a bright, sizzling hat, and lower ones a duller, softer one.

parameters.name: Open hat decay
parameters.description: Time to fall 60 dB (a closed hat cuts it in 5 ms)
parameters.how: Sets how long the open hat rings, from 50 ms to 4 seconds; a closed hat cuts it off.
parameters.sound: Short decays sound like a half-open hat, and long ones like a wide, splashing hat.

parameters.name: Open hat level
parameters.description: Level of the open hat
parameters.how: Sets the level of the open hat, from -60 to +6 dB, or off.
parameters.sound: Use it to balance the hat against the other drums.

parameters.name: Open hat pan
parameters.description: Where the open hat sits, from −100 % (left) to +100 % (right)
parameters.how: Places the open hat from 100 % left to 100 % right.
parameters.sound: Moving the hats slightly off-centre widens the top of the kit.

parameters.name: Low tom tune
parameters.description: The tom's pitch once its sweep has settled (it starts 1.2 octaves above, falls an octave in about 25 ms, then the rest over about a second)
parameters.how: Sets the pitch the low tom settles on, from 40 to 500 Hz.
parameters.sound: Lower values sound big and booming, and higher ones short and tuned.

parameters.name: Low tom decay
parameters.description: Time to fall 60 dB
parameters.how: Sets how long the low tom rings, from 0.05 to 3 seconds.
parameters.sound: Short decays are tight and dry, and long ones sing out like a floor tom.

parameters.name: Low tom tone
parameters.description: Level of the attack's noise
parameters.how: Sets the level of the noisy attack of the low tom, from 0 to 100 %.
parameters.sound: More tone adds a stick-on-skin click, and less leaves a smooth, round sound.

parameters.name: Low tom level
parameters.description: Level of the low tom
parameters.how: Sets the level of the low tom, from -60 to +6 dB, or off.
parameters.sound: Use it to balance the tom against the other drums.

parameters.name: Low tom pan
parameters.description: Where the low tom sits, from −100 % (left) to +100 % (right)
parameters.how: Places the low tom from 100 % left to 100 % right.
parameters.sound: Spreading the three toms from left to right gives fills a natural sweep.

parameters.name: Mid tom tune
parameters.description: The tom's pitch once its sweep has settled (it starts 1.2 octaves above, falls an octave in about 25 ms, then the rest over about a second)
parameters.how: Sets the pitch the mid tom settles on, from 40 to 500 Hz.
parameters.sound: Lower values sound big and booming, and higher ones short and tuned.

parameters.name: Mid tom decay
parameters.description: Time to fall 60 dB
parameters.how: Sets how long the mid tom rings, from 0.05 to 3 seconds.
parameters.sound: Short decays are tight and dry, and long ones sing out like a floor tom.

parameters.name: Mid tom tone
parameters.description: Level of the attack's noise
parameters.how: Sets the level of the noisy attack of the mid tom, from 0 to 100 %.
parameters.sound: More tone adds a stick-on-skin click, and less leaves a smooth, round sound.

parameters.name: Mid tom level
parameters.description: Level of the mid tom
parameters.how: Sets the level of the mid tom, from -60 to +6 dB, or off.
parameters.sound: Use it to balance the tom against the other drums.

parameters.name: Mid tom pan
parameters.description: Where the mid tom sits, from −100 % (left) to +100 % (right)
parameters.how: Places the mid tom from 100 % left to 100 % right.
parameters.sound: Spreading the three toms from left to right gives fills a natural sweep.

parameters.name: High tom tune
parameters.description: The tom's pitch once its sweep has settled (it starts 1.2 octaves above, falls an octave in about 25 ms, then the rest over about a second)
parameters.how: Sets the pitch the high tom settles on, from 40 to 500 Hz.
parameters.sound: Lower values sound big and booming, and higher ones short and tuned.

parameters.name: High tom decay
parameters.description: Time to fall 60 dB
parameters.how: Sets how long the high tom rings, from 0.05 to 3 seconds.
parameters.sound: Short decays are tight and dry, and long ones sing out like a floor tom.

parameters.name: High tom tone
parameters.description: Level of the attack's noise
parameters.how: Sets the level of the noisy attack of the high tom, from 0 to 100 %.
parameters.sound: More tone adds a stick-on-skin click, and less leaves a smooth, round sound.

parameters.name: High tom level
parameters.description: Level of the high tom
parameters.how: Sets the level of the high tom, from -60 to +6 dB, or off.
parameters.sound: Use it to balance the tom against the other drums.

parameters.name: High tom pan
parameters.description: Where the high tom sits, from −100 % (left) to +100 % (right)
parameters.how: Places the high tom from 100 % left to 100 % right.
parameters.sound: Spreading the three toms from left to right gives fills a natural sweep.

parameters.name: Cowbell tune
parameters.description: Pitch of the lower of its two square waves (the upper sits 1.48 times above)
parameters.how: Sets the pitch of the cowbell, from 300 Hz to 1.5 kHz.
parameters.sound: Lower values clunk like a big bell, and higher ones ring like a small one.

parameters.name: Cowbell decay
parameters.description: Time for its tail to fall 60 dB (the attack falls faster)
parameters.how: Sets how long the cowbell rings, from 20 ms to 2 seconds.
parameters.sound: Short decays are a dry clack, and longer ones a ringing bell.

parameters.name: Cowbell level
parameters.description: Level of the cowbell
parameters.how: Sets the level of the cowbell, from -60 to +6 dB, or off.
parameters.sound: Use it to balance the cowbell against the other drums.

parameters.name: Cowbell pan
parameters.description: Where the cowbell sits, from −100 % (left) to +100 % (right)
parameters.how: Places the cowbell from 100 % left to 100 % right.
parameters.sound: Moving it aside keeps it from crowding the centre.

parameters.name: Crash tune
parameters.description: Pitch of the six metallic oscillators, in semitones from where they sit
parameters.how: Shifts the pitch of the crash by up to 12 semitones either way.
parameters.sound: Lower values sound bigger and darker, and higher ones lighter and thinner.

parameters.name: Crash tone
parameters.description: Centre of the wide band it rings in (more above it, a little across the mids): brighter up
parameters.how: Sets the centre of the band the crash rings in, from 1 to 16 kHz.
parameters.sound: Higher values give a brighter, harsher cymbal, and lower ones a softer, darker one.

parameters.name: Crash decay
parameters.description: Time to fall 60 dB
parameters.how: Sets how long the crash rings, from 0.2 to 8 seconds.
parameters.sound: Short decays are a quick accent, and long ones a washy cymbal that fills the space.

parameters.name: Crash level
parameters.description: Level of the crash
parameters.how: Sets the level of the crash, from -60 to +6 dB, or off.
parameters.sound: Use it to balance the cymbal against the other drums.

parameters.name: Crash pan
parameters.description: Where the crash sits, from −100 % (left) to +100 % (right)
parameters.how: Places the crash from 100 % left to 100 % right.
parameters.sound: A slight offset gives the cymbal a place in the kit's stereo picture.

parameters.name: Ride tune
parameters.description: Pitch of the six metallic oscillators, in semitones from where they sit
parameters.how: Shifts the pitch of the ride by up to 12 semitones either way.
parameters.sound: Lower values sound bigger and darker, and higher ones lighter and thinner.

parameters.name: Ride tone
parameters.description: Centre of the band it pings in (more above it, a little across the mids): brighter up
parameters.how: Sets the centre of the band the ride rings in, from 1 to 16 kHz.
parameters.sound: Higher values give a brighter, harsher cymbal, and lower ones a softer, darker one.

parameters.name: Ride decay
parameters.description: Time to fall 60 dB
parameters.how: Sets how long the ride rings, from 0.2 to 8 seconds.
parameters.sound: Short decays are a quick accent, and long ones a washy cymbal that fills the space.

parameters.name: Ride level
parameters.description: Level of the ride
parameters.how: Sets the level of the ride, from -60 to +6 dB, or off.
parameters.sound: Use it to balance the cymbal against the other drums.

parameters.name: Ride pan
parameters.description: Where the ride sits, from −100 % (left) to +100 % (right)
parameters.how: Places the ride from 100 % left to 100 % right.
parameters.sound: A slight offset gives the cymbal a place in the kit's stereo picture.
